entry.summary: No visa of its own: Andorra is reached through Schengen territory, and Australians are visa-exempt there under Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 (90 days in any 180). Andorra is outside Schengen, so leaving and re-entering counts again.
entry.next_check: Confirm Andorra's own entry rule and how border crossings are recorded under the Entry/Exit System.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: Visa-free (entry via France or Spain - Schengen rules apply).

steps: Meet Schengen entry rules for France or Spain on the way in.

items.text: Cannabis is illegal. Using, growing, bringing in or holding drugs for your own use is punished with arrest and a fine of EUR 500 to 1,200; in public or in company, EUR 600 to 1,500.
